key_moments: Both teams scored one goal each, resulting in a draw.
matches.tactical_summary: The match saw a balanced contest with neither side able to secure a decisive advantage. Both teams demonstrated defensive solidity while also creating opportunities, leading to a shared point.

narrative: Tunisia secured their first point of the tournament with a 1-1 draw against Japan, keeping their slim hopes alive in Group F. Japan, despite the draw, remains in contention for the knockout stages, though they will need a strong performance in their final group match.
